evals.prompt: Work on issue #12 in this repo. Implement whatever it asks for.
evals.expected_output: Agent fetches issue #12, reads project context files, explores relevant source and test modules, creates a worktree on a feature branch, writes a failing test, implements the change, runs validation, commits with a closes-#12 message, and opens a PR.

assertions.name: fetches_issue
assertions.description: Agent runs gh issue view 12 or equivalent before writing any code

assertions.name: creates_worktree_branch
assertions.description: Agent creates an isolated worktree on a new feature branch (git worktree add ... -b ...) before writing code

assertions.name: writes_test_first
assertions.description: Agent writes and runs a failing test before implementing the change

assertions.name: opens_pr
assertions.description: Agent opens a PR with gh pr create

evals.prompt: I don't have a specific issue in mind — pick the next ready-for-agent one and implement it.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs dispatch.sh (or falls back to gh issue list --label ready-for-agent), identifies the lowest-numbered unblocked issue, then follows the full workflow for that issue.

assertions.name: runs_dispatch
assertions.description: Agent runs dispatch.sh or gh issue list --label ready-for-agent to discover the issue

assertions.name: picks_lowest_number
assertions.description: Agent selects the lowest-numbered unblocked issue, not a random one

assertions.name: follows_full_workflow
assertions.description: Agent proceeds through gather-context, explore, implement, validate, commit, and PR steps

evals.prompt: Close issue #7. It's been sitting in our backlog forever.
evals.expected_output: Despite the casual phrasing, agent recognizes this as an implementation request, fetches issue #7, and follows the full TDD workflow through to an opened PR.

assertions.name: skill_triggers
assertions.description: Skill is invoked despite 'close issue' phrasing rather than 'work on' or 'implement'

assertions.name: reads_context_files
assertions.description: Agent reads AGENTS.md, docs/agents/domain.md, or equivalent context files if they exist

assertions.name: stays_focused
assertions.description: Agent does not fix unrelated bugs or refactor code outside the issue scope
